newsitem.title: USA: Mercer ends talks on buying paper unit.
newsitem.headline: Mercer ends talks on buying paper unit.

text.p: Mercer International Inc said Wednesday it had ended negotiations with its German joint venture partner concerning the potential acquisition of a paper operation.

Talks for the deal, announced on November 15, ended because of questions related to future claims by shareholders and other stakeholders, access to full and complete environmental issues, and differences in regards to price, the pulp and paper company said.
The potential seller was not identified.

Mercer, based in Zurich, Switzerland, said it will continue to pursue acquisition opportunities as well as its internal growth strategy, which includes the conversion and expansion of its pulp mill from its current production of 160,000 tonnes of sulphite pulp to 280,000 tonnes.
